findings.description: When the target already exists, the function returns early without removing the temporary file in incoming/. Every duplicate upload leaves a full-size orphan file, so disk usage grows without bound. The old code wrote nothing in this case.
findings.suggestion: Call incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True) before returning. Better, wrap the post-write section in try/finally that removes incoming if it was not moved.
findings.title: Temp upload file leaked when blob already exists

findings.description: The cleanup try/except covers only the write loop. If _path_for, target.parent.mkdir or os.replace raises (permissions, disk error), the temp file in incoming/ remains.
findings.suggestion: Extend the cleanup to cover the finalize steps, for example with try/finally that unlinks incoming if it still exists.
findings.title: Temp file leaked if mkdir or os.replace fails
